caller_path: Surface commit first passes callbacks through the hidden-window holder. Hidden windows without a cast retain up to 16 per window; excess oldest callbacks return to commit pacing. Showing, cast-window transitions, explicit close requests and a scheduled one-second trickle drain held callbacks directly through send_frames. Separately, answer_when_shown queues eligible submitted/held frames only when the engine reports frames; otherwise it answers immediately. FrameDone answers through done(frame <= reported), and the engine-report queue has a 250 ms fallback. Locked Rust display.sync separately calls done(0).
conditions: Surface callback timestamp is now_ms when send_frames runs, independent of engine shown time. Hidden-window trickle and engine-report fallback are separate source timers, without measured punctuality or physical-presentation guarantee. Display.sync path is conditional on selected Rust backend; compiled choice unverified.
recipient: Original callback resources grouped by parent window for hidden/popup/bubble holding, or by app/frame for engine-report pacing; display.sync belongs to its requesting client.
